sources.title: BruceYg/ATPO-G-Qwen2.5-VL-7B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: ATPO-G-Qwen2.5-VL-7B ATPO-G-Qwen2.5-VL-7B is based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct and fine-tuned for multi-label video safety detection using Adaptive Tversky Policy Optimization (ATPO). The ATPO-G variant uses Global Adaptive Tversky Reward (G-ATR), which adapts false-positive and false-negative penalties during reinforcement learning to steer the precision-recall trade-off.
